exposure: Circadian blood pressure (BP) variation (dipper, non-dipper, reverse dipper type)
outcome: Rate of low birth weight infants
cohort: The study included 173 women with preeclampsia (PE) with severe features.
finding: Aberrant circadian patterns of blood pressure in women with PE with severe features were associated with several adverse maternal and perinatal outcomes.
birth_weight: Measured (mean birth weight, rate of low birth weight infants)
